ruleDefinitions.name: T1047 Wmiprvse Wbemcomn DLL Hijack
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a threat actor creating a file named `wbemcomn.dll` in the `C:\Windows\System32\wbem\` directory over the network for a WMI DLL Hijack scenario. Note: Unmapped fields: RelativeTargetName

sequences.query: (event_id = 5145 AND RelativeTargetName = RGX("\\\\wbem\\\\wbemcomn\\\.dll$")) AND  NOT (user = RGX("\\$$"))
